name: io.github.dylancaponi/agent-press-wire
title: Agent Press Wire
description: Announce launches and distribute press releases to 500+ news sites. Pay per call in USDC (x402).

environmentVariables.name: X402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of YOUR OWN Base wallet holding USDC, used to pay per call via x402. Omit for quote-only mode.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Max USD the server may pay for a single call. 0 (default) = quote only, never pays. Prices: $1 newsroom, $99 wire, $299 premium wire.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_TOTAL_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Lifetime cap in USD across all calls and restarts, tracked in a ledger at ~/.agent-press-wire/spend.json. Defaults to MAX_SPEND_USD (one paid call's worth).

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRESS_WIRE_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the spend ledger (spend.json). Default ~/.agent-press-wire.

environmentVariables.name: PRESS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (testing only).
